correctness.rationale: For arbitrary positive content c on k>=3 symbols, B_ab(vu)-B_ab(uv)=c_a s_b-c_b s_a, so equal scattered ordered-pair profiles iff the intervening segment Parikh vector is length*c/N. Coprime p=c/d forces segment length a multiple of L=N/d. Hence the L residue classes of indexed rotation starts are distinct; equality L forces all length-L windows balanced, so successive window differences force w=v^d. A grouped word with k>=3 monochromatic runs cannot have a proper circular interval containing a strict fraction of each run (only two boundary runs), attaining N. For arbitrary w, centered prefix counts H_i=N P_i-i c have equalities exactly the collision equivalence; a neighboring transposition changes only H_{t+1}, so distinct-count changes by at most one while sorting v^d into grouped form, realizing the entire interval. Cases d=1 and repeated literal rotations follow. Independent direct/prefix enumerations corroborate, not replace, the all-content proof.
